Nutrien said it had completed the strategic review of its Phosphate business and added that it would retain and further optimize its Aurora and integrated upgrade facilities, while shutting down operations at its White Springs facility in the second quarter of 2027.

The Saskatoon, Canada-based firm posted an adjusted profit of 61 cents per share for the three months ended September 30, compared with analysts' average estimate of 80 cents per share, according to data compiled by LSEG.
